fig_5_1_dfd0.title: Fig 5.1 DFD Level 0
fig_5_1_dfd0.caption: Fig 5.1 DFD Level 0 (Context Diagram)
fig_5_1_dfd0.description: The DFD Level 0 diagram, or Context Diagram, illustrates the high-level boundary of the Smart Attendance System Using Face Recognition. It depicts interactions between primary external entities—System Admin, Faculty/Teacher, and Student—and the central system process, along with data persistent stores. System inputs such as image capture and course configurations yield automated outputs including attendance logs and analytics.
fig_5_1_dfd0.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Admin["👤 System Admin"] -->|"Enrollment Data & System Config"| P0(["0.0 Smart Attendance System"])
    P0 -->|"System Status & Analytics"| Admin
    Teacher["🧑‍🏫 Faculty / Teacher"] -->|"Start Session / Video Stream"| P0
    P0 -->|"Attendance Summary & Reports"| Teacher
    Student["🎓 Student"] -->|"Facial Feature Capture"| P0
    P0 <-->|"Read/Write Master & Logs"| DB[("SQLite Database & Embedding Store")]

fig_5_2_dfd1.title: Fig 5.2 DFD Level 1
fig_5_2_dfd1.caption: Fig 5.2 DFD Level 1
fig_5_2_dfd1.description: The DFD Level 1 diagram decomposes the system into three major functional processes: Student Registration & Encoding, Live Recognition Engine, and Attendance Logging & Analytics. It maps data movement from raw external inputs into key data stores including the Student Master Database (D1), Pre-trained Embeddings File (D2), and Attendance Logs Database (D3).
fig_5_2_dfd1.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Admin["👤 Admin"] -->|"Student Details & Images"| P1(["1.0 Student Registration & Encoding"])
    P1 -->|"Master Student Records"| D1[("D1 Student Master Database")]
    P1 -->|"128-d Face Vectors"| D2[("D2 Pre-trained Embeddings Cache")]
    Teacher["🧑‍🏫 Faculty"] -->|"Start Class / Session Trigger"| P2(["2.0 Live Recognition Engine"])
    Student["🎓 Student"] -->|"Live Camera Feed Frames"| P2
    D2 -->|"Stored Reference Embeddings"| P2
    P2 -->|"Matched Roll No & Timestamp"| P3(["3.0 Attendance Logging & Analytics"])
    P3 -->|"Write Attendance Entries"| D3[("D3 Attendance Logs DB")]
    D3 -->|"Query Historical Logs"| P3
    P3 -->|"Real-time Dashboard & Export CSV"| Teacher

fig_5_3_dfd2.title: Fig 5.3 DFD Level 2
fig_5_3_dfd2.caption: Fig 5.3 DFD Level 2
fig_5_3_dfd2.description: The DFD Level 2 diagram elaborates on the internal sub-processes of Process 2.0 (Live Recognition Engine). It highlights the sequential execution steps including HOG-based face detection, 128-dimensional feature vector extraction via dlib, Euclidean distance comparison against pre-computed vectors with a 0.6 threshold, and final status dispatch to persistent stores.
fig_5_3_dfd2.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Cam["Classroom Camera Feed"] -->|"Raw Video Frames"| P21(["2.1 Frame Capture & HOG Detection"])
    P21 -->|"Cropped Face Bounding Box"| P22(["2.2 Feature Extraction & Embedding"])
    P22 -->|"128-d Input Vector"| P23(["2.3 Euclidean Distance Matching"])
    D2[("D2 Embeddings Cache")] -->|"Reference Vectors"| P23
    P23 -->|"Match Status (Distance < 0.6)"| P24(["2.4 Verification & Log Trigger"])
    P24 -->|"Roll Number & Timestamp"| D3[("D3 Attendance Logs DB")]
    P24 -->|"Live Recognition Status Feed"| UI["Flask Web Admin Dashboard"]

fig_5_4_block_diagram.title: Fig 5.4 Block Diagram
fig_5_4_block_diagram.caption: Fig 5.4 Block Diagram (Overall System Architecture)
fig_5_4_block_diagram.description: The Block Diagram depicts the multi-tiered structural architecture of the Smart Attendance System. It visually separates the system into User Tier, Ingestion Tier, Core Processing Pipeline (featuring OpenCV and dlib modules), Data Persistence Tier (SQLite and local cache files), and Presentation Tier for real-time reporting.
fig_5_4_block_diagram.mermaid:
graph TB
    subgraph USERS["User Tier"]
        Admin["System Admin"]
        Faculty["Faculty / Teacher"]
        Student["Student"]
    end
    subgraph INPUT["Input & Ingestion Tier"]
        Cam["Classroom Webcam Feed"]
        WebUI["Flask Web Portal UI"]
    end
    subgraph PROCESSING["Core Processing Engine"]
        P1_Detect["HOG Face Detection"]
        P2_Preproc["Frame Normalization"]
        P3_Embed["dlib 128-d Encoding"]
        P4_Match["Euclidean Distance Matcher"]
    end
    subgraph STORAGE["Data Persistence Tier"]
        D1_Master[("SQLite Master DB")]
        D2_Embed[("Embeddings File .npy")]
        D3_Logs[("SQLite Logs DB")]
    end
    subgraph OUTPUT["Output & Analytics Tier"]
        Out_Dash["Real-time Web Dashboard"]
        Out_Reports["Exportable CSV/Excel Reports"]
    end
    Faculty -->|"Initiates Session"| WebUI
    Admin -->|"Enrolls Profiles"| WebUI
    Cam -->|"Stream Frames"| P1_Detect
    P1_Detect -->|"Face Region"| P2_Preproc
    P2_Preproc -->|"Normalized Image"| P3_Embed
    P3_Embed -->|"128-d Vector"| P4_Match
    D2_Embed -->|"Known Vectors"| P4_Match
    P4_Match -->|"Verified Match"| D3_Logs
    WebUI -->|"Fetch Master Data"| D1_Master
    D3_Logs -->|"Aggregated Data"| Out_Dash
    D3_Logs -->|"Export Engine"| Out_Reports

fig_5_5_activity_diagram.title: Fig 5.5 Activity Diagram
fig_5_5_activity_diagram.caption: Fig 5.5 Activity Diagram
fig_5_5_activity_diagram.description: The Activity Diagram details the end-to-end operational control flow of the application. It outlines authentication verification, role-based routing (Admin enrollment vs. Teacher lecture execution), real-time face matching evaluation against threshold requirements, automatic SQLite logging, and eventual CSV report generation.
fig_5_5_activity_diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Start(["Start System Session"]) --> Login["User Accesses Web App & Authenticates"]
    Login --> Decision1{"Valid Credentials?"}
    Decision1 -->|"No"| Login
    Decision1 -->|"Yes"| RoleCheck{"User Role?"}
    RoleCheck -->|"Admin"| Enroll["Upload Student Details & Image"]
    Enroll --> GenEmbed["Generate 128-d Feature Embedding"]
    GenEmbed --> SaveDB["Save to Master SQLite & Vector Store"]
    SaveDB --> End(["End Session"])
    RoleCheck -->|"Teacher"| StartStream["Activate Live Lecture Camera Feed"]
    StartStream --> DetectFace["Perform HOG Face Detection"]
    DetectFace --> ExtractVec["Extract 128-d Vector"]
    ExtractVec --> CompareDist{"Euclidean Distance < 0.6?"}
    CompareDist -->|"Yes"| LogAttendance["Log Roll No & Timestamp into SQLite"]
    CompareDist -->|"No"| DropFrame["Ignore Frame / Drop Unmatched"]
    LogAttendance --> GenReport["Update Real-Time Dashboard & Export CSV"]
    DropFrame --> GenReport
    GenReport --> End
    RoleCheck -->|"Student"| ViewReports["View Attendance Stats & Defaulter List"]
    ViewReports --> End

fig_5_6_use_case.caption: Fig 5.6 Use Case Diagram

It represents functional dependencies such as automated facial vector matching and attendance timestamp logging embedded within active stream sessions.

flowchart LR
    Admin["👤 System Admin"]
    Teacher["🧑‍🏫 Faculty / Teacher"]
    Student["🎓 Student"]
    subgraph Boundary["System Boundary: Smart Attendance System"]
        UC1(["UC1: Register & Encode Student Profile"])
        UC2(["UC2: Initiate Live Class Stream"])
        UC3(["UC3: Detect & Match Facial Vectors"])
        UC4(["UC4: Log Attendance Timestamp"])
        UC5(["UC5: View Real-Time Dashboard"])
        UC6(["UC6: Export Reports CSV/Excel"])
    end
    Admin --> UC1
    Admin --> UC5
    Teacher --> UC2
    Teacher --> UC5
    Teacher --> UC6
    UC2 -.->|"includes"| UC3
    UC3 -.->|"includes"| UC4
    Student --> UC5
